content: Real NihonGO application screens rendered with synthetic demonstration data. No real account, token or private content is included.

web.renderer: Chrome, 1440 × 1000 viewport, development application with local API fixtures

screens.web-shadowing.webp: ShadowingScreen, sample lesson with Japanese captions
screens.web-speaking-conversation.webp: SpeakingScenariosScreen, saved conversation with Aoi 3D and Japanese transcript
screens.web-writing-feedback.webp: WritingWorkspaceScreen, graded submission with score, highlighted correction and explanation

app.renderer: Native React Native views on iPhone 17 Pro, iOS 26.5 simulator, 1206 × 2622 screenshot
app.captureOnlyAdapters: Notifications and speech playback disabled in the temporary capture harness; no UI components were substituted. All temporary source changes were restored after capture.

optimization: Screenshots resized and encoded as WebP; mascot images are optimized derivatives of existing src/assets/mascot PNG files.
